flow.method: OpenCV DIS (medium), backward t->t-1 with forward-backward consistency
flow.uv: texture coordinates advected along smoothed trusted flow (moves under 0.5 px held still); revealed surface extended from the nearest trusted pixel; two layers cross-weighted by a per-point phase that advances by (deformation - 0.03)/0.25 per frame while a point moves (held, rigid and undeformed points never change weight); a layer re-anchors only where its phase wraps, copying the other layer where its interior deformation is under 0.015-0.03 (feathered) and restarting only deformed texture; stored as uint16 = uv*8+32768

review.notes: screentone stays on chair, dress and cape without marbling or shimmer; speed lines appear only while the right leg uncrosses (about frames 20-32) and trail behind the foot; outline and motion follow the plate
